params.name: account_label
params.description: Filter by account label (e.g., `general`, `sub_account_test`). Account labels are used to categorize accounts under a participant. Each participant `account_label` maintains a separate balance and transaction history.

params.name: market_identifier_code
params.description: Filters for trades within a designated `market_identifier_code`.

params.name: omit_market_identifier_code
params.description: Filters for trades excluding those from a particular `market_identifier_code`.

params.name: platform_code
params.description: Filters for trades based on the specific `platform_code` where the trade execution took place.

params.name: omit_platform_code
params.description: Filters for trades based excluding those from a particular `platform_code`.

params.name: trade_state
params.description: Filters for trades based on their current `trade_state`.

params.name: settlement_state
params.description: Filters for trades based on their current `settlement_state`.

params.name: party_code
params.description: Filters for trades where the provided `party_code` is at least one of the counterparties to a trade in the `parties` array.

params.name: transaction_timestamp[gt]
params.description: Filters for trades with a timestamp greater than the provided value, which can be defined in milliseconds or nanoseconds.

params.name: transaction_timestamp[gte]
params.description: Filters for trades with a timestamp greater than or equal to the provided value, which can be defined in milliseconds or nanoseconds.

params.name: transaction_timestamp[e]
params.description: Filters for trades with a timestamp equal to the provided value, which can be defined in milliseconds or nanoseconds.

params.name: transaction_timestamp[lt]
params.description: Filters for trades with a timestamp less than the provided value, which can be defined in milliseconds or nanoseconds.

params.name: transaction_timestamp[lte]
params.description: Filters for trades with a timestamp less than or equal to the provided value, which can be defined in milliseconds or nanoseconds.

params.name: client_trade_id
params.description:
Filters for trades with the provided `client_trade_id` value.
Note:
 - Platforms integrated to the zerohash RFQ systems, the `quote_id` from the RFQ will be saved as the `client_trade_id` once the quote has been executed.
- Platforms integrated to the zerohash CLOB, the `execution_id` from the order trade execution will be saved as the `client_trade_id` on the resulting trade.

params.name: execution_id
params.description: Filters for trades with the provided `execution_id` in either party's `execution_id` field.

params.name: reporting_party
params.description: Filters for trades based on the `reporting_party` associated with each trade.

params.name: settlement_schedule
params.description: Filters for trades based on the `settlement_schedule` associated with each trade.
